item.title: Huwell selects Cherokee County for first U.S. plant
item.description: Italian cosmetics manufacturer Huwell is investing $11.6 million in a Gaffney facility, creating 25 jobs and expanding U.S. production of hair lighteners. The post Huwell selects Cherokee County for first U.S. plant appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Tribute Portfolio opens first hotel in the Lowcountry
item.description: Live Oak Charleston, a new downtown hotel, plans to open in April with 120 rooms, a salt-water pool and a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant. The post Tribute Portfolio opens first hotel in the Lowcountry appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Nixtamal Mexican Kitchen opens at BridgeWay Station
item.description: Nixtamal Mexican Kitchen opens at BridgeWay Station as the Juarez family explores creating an umbrella company to manage its various food-related enterprises. The post Nixtamal Mexican Kitchen opens at BridgeWay Station appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Columbia breaks ground on new Olympia Fire Station 2
item.description: Columbia-Richland Fire Department breaks ground on a $10 million Fire Station 2 in Olympia, a 15,000-square-foot facility to support regional growth. The post Columbia breaks ground on new Olympia Fire Station 2 appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Cohn Construction completes GoAtlas HQ in Ridgeville
item.description: GoAtlas has opened its new 31,200-square-foot headquarters and production facility in Ridgeville, built by Cohn Construction to support expanded manufacturing and distribution operations. (Photo/Cohn Construction) The post Cohn Construction completes GoAtlas HQ in Ridgeville appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Greenville Literary Association launches adult entrepreneurship program
